name: Agent Queue
description: The agent task queue of agent-queue-kit as an Orca plugin: a panel in Orca's right sidebar and its worker. A skeleton: its functions come with the MVP.

settings.title: Interface language
settings.description: Language of the texts of the Agent Queue panel.

settings.title: Queue check interval, minutes
settings.description: How often the coordinator of this computer checks the queues of the connected projects: a whole number of minutes, at least 1.

settings.title: Merge notifications
settings.description: Show a notification when a task is merged. Notifications about blocked tasks are always shown.

settings.title: Coordinator on this computer
settings.description: When off, the coordinator of this computer takes and runs no tasks; the panel only shows the queue.
